info.title: OudGuide reference interface contract
info.description: Reference only, not a running API. GenericResult/GenericAction entries identify places requiring endpoint-specific finalized schemas before code generation. All personal data flows require authorization beyond authentication.

servers.description: Illustrative only; do not deploy this hostname

get.description: Actor: public. Typed filters: role_id, family_id, seller_place_id, origin_place_id, destination_place_id, cursor; validate/limit combinations.
Actor: public. Disabled contacts omitted; owner approval + entitlement + moderation required to include them.

patch.description: Actor: authorized owner. Version checked; moderated facts; contact eligibility separate.

get.description: Actor: public. Locale query; only public published revision; never expose draft blocks.

post.description: Actor: buyer or anonymous protected service. Validate service notice; matching initially only OudGuide operations. No external PII release.
Actor: buyer challenge holder. Challenge scoped to inquiry and session; attempt/expiry limits; no contact details in response.

get.description: Actor: verified buyer. Strong ownership authorization; secure opaque receipt alone not universal authority.
Actor: verified buyer. Real supplier identity and affiliation plus approval scope before introduction.

post.description: Actor: verified buyer. Server validates identity version; purpose, cap and jurisdiction checks; persists grant.
Actor: verified buyer. Cancel queued releases; propagate suppression to prior recipients as applicable.
Actor: verified buyer. No further introductions after close without explicit reopening and new validation.
Actor: verified buyer. Size/type allowlist; quarantine; expiring signed storage path; scanning before approval.
Actor: authenticated claimant. Payment not proof of ownership; evidence kept private.
Actor: authorized owner. Exact approved plan/terms from server; no activation from return URL.
Actor: authorized business owner. Contract, identity and capability checks separate from directory membership.

get.description: Actor: approved partner. Return RedactedOpportunity objects only after re-identification review; no buyer PII.

post.description: Actor: approved partner. No contact release or promise of buyer selection.
Actor: approved partner. Payment does not override recipient grant; recheck before capture/release.

get.description: Actor: specific authorized recipient. Field/channel-scoped view; actor organization must match recipient; no unrelated requests.

post.description: Actor: specific authorized recipient. A message sent is not assumed delivered or accepted; truthful status transitions.
Actor: public protected intake. No payment condition; authenticate before disclosing any private case status.
Actor: verified relevant person. Identity/scoped request review and jurisdiction deadline handling.
Actor: authorized editorial reviewer. Claim/source/link/media/metadata gates; role separation and audit.
Actor: private service identity. Not internet-public. Atomic locking + current grant/cap/payment/policy checks, outbox dedupe.
Actor: payment provider. Provider-specific raw payload, signature/timestamp verification and event dedupe required; no session auth.

sessionAuth.description: Illustrative authenticated session; production may use secure cookies with CSRF protection.

providerSignature.name: X-Provider-Signature
providerSignature.description: Illustrative name only; implement actual selected provider signature protocol.

GenericResult.description: Endpoint-specific safe projection; finalize strict schema before implementation. Never return raw private rows.
